explicit_zero_validity.claim: Local mode requires explicit fixed Liechtenstein U/J, nsp=1, lmax=2, and numeric U=J=0 is allowed as a no-op.

input_override.claim: Explicit hubbard_u_general and hubbard_j_general values are assigned to each symbolic potential, overriding values loaded from its restart potential.

mode_validation.claim: Mode validation checks active potential U/J; the explicit U0 override makes the U/J arrays inactive, so the saved U2 mode marker does not trigger an incompatible-mode rejection. It does not rewrite or edit the seed metadata before restart.

saved_seed_metadata.claim: Potential reader retains the saved radial mode/backend and records whether the restart file has nonzero U/J metadata. The selected seed is U2, J0, local, RS; U2 is stored as 0.14699717144573571 internal Ry.
